blocks.title: Hotel search failure playbook
rows: A reply for an older query arrives late
Compare its queryId with the current one and ignore it
Cards never belong to a different filter set than the URL
Show an error state in the results slot with a retry; the inputs and the filters keep working
The URL still holds the search, so a retry needs no re-entry
The shell renders a fallback in that slot and reports the build; the other units keep working
A broken filters build cannot blank the results
The price changed since the quote
The property page refetches and shows the new price with its time
A traveller never pays a price the page invented

blocks.text: Caching from the CDN to the browser

Hashed assets are published with a long lifetime and marked immutable, so a release never needs a purge. HTML is served with a short lifetime and a build version header. Search replies are private and live briefly in the browser; the CDN never caches a reply that carries a guest's identity. Listing content is cached at the edge under surrogate keys and purged by hotelId when a hotel is edited.

blocks.title: Scenario walkthrough: a release by the filters team

steps.title: Build and test
steps.text: The filters team ships build f_219 with a new facet. CI runs the shell's contract test against it, publishes the hashed assets, and only then points the manifest at f_219.

steps.title: Roll out by share
steps.text: The manifest serves f_219 to a measured share of new visits first, while the previous build stays published for every open tab.

steps.title: Watch the vitals
steps.text: LCP, INP and the error rate for the filters slot are split by buildId, so f_219 is compared with f_218 on the same routes.

steps.title: Roll back one unit
steps.text: If f_219 worsens INP on phones, the manifest points back to f_218 for new visits; no other team's unit moves.

blocks.text: Testing and measurement for the search page

blocks.title: Hotel search tests that protect bookings
items: Change a filter while a reply is in flight; assert the late reply never renders.
Open a shared link; assert the inputs, the filters and the cards all match the URL.
Mount a unit with an older contractVersion; assert the shell refuses it and reports the build.
Run keyboard and screen-reader passes over the combobox, the date picker, the filter group and the results live region.

blocks.text: Track LCP, INP and CLS per route and per unit build at p75, the time from search to first cards, the share of replies ignored as stale, and the search-to-view-to-book-to-pay funnel keyed by searchId, split by device class. A release is judged by the change in those numbers for its own unit.
